items.goal: Produce one useful supplier qualification worksheet for the existing live IWMS tender brief. First check equivalent completed evidence and read the existing IWMS checklist, official notice, latest verified release and relevant lessons. Preserve observed facts while reconsidering conclusions only within their scope. Use the exact official submission portal cited by the saved notice; inspect at most two directly linked public pages or documents, without guessing endpoints, logging in or bypassing restrictions. Seek concrete mandatory participation requirements, required submission documents, evaluation gates and clarification deadlines. If publicly accessible authoritative evidence supports it, prepare a concise sourced EN/FR worksheet separating mandatory requirements, conditional requirements, recommendations and unknowns, with exact quotations, URLs, observation time and source hashes. Do not infer qualification from missing requirements or claim tender-pack completeness. If documents are inaccessible or equivalent work already exists, save a precise bounded result and stop without speculative worksheet inventory. Save and read evidence under products/services/open-software-tenders/supplier-qualification/. No accounts, agreements, outreach, submission, spending, private correspondence or public edits. Any later publication requires fresh exact-digest independent review and host-gated deployment. Complete only with an actual valid lease, saved/read evidence and a lesson. Preserve all current observation windows, December notice expiry duties, January page retirement and December 4 welfare retirement. This deliverable establishes neither buyer demand nor revenue.

Resolve the existing SQLite offer's disclosed untested C execution with one bounded delivery attempt. Check equivalent completed evidence first, including repro/c-loader-attempt.txt, acceptance.json and relevant lessons; reuse any complete result. Read the existing multi_stmt.c and its documented expected behavior. Check installed compiler, SQLite headers and linker availability once. If available, compile the unchanged downloadable source in a fresh offline directory, execute it and compare actual observations with its documented acceptance criteria. Save commands, exit codes, source hashes and output under products/services/sqlite-native-delivery/. If prerequisites are absent, save the precise limitation and stop without installation or repeated capability audits. Do not substitute ctypes execution for native C execution. Correct no source or public files in this mission; report any concrete defect and its smallest correction. Read saved evidence before closure with an actual valid lease and a lesson. This tests delivery usability, not paid demand or revenue. No new product, market scan, accounts, outreach, spending or deployment. Preserve all observation and retirement duties; any eventual public revision requires exact-digest independent review and host-gated deployment.

Test the specific reconsideration trigger in products/services/software-renewals/evidence.json using Contracts Finder rather than repeating Find a Tender discovery. Check equivalent work and claim actual ownership first. Read the prior bounded result and saved Contracts Finder API documentation, including the actual receipt for search-documentation.html. Follow documented public GET routes only; no authentication, guessed endpoints or POST operations. Inspect at most five award notices, selecting software-support or maintenance contracts where possible through documented search. Seek explicit contract end dates between February and November 2027, named buyer and supplier organizations, scope, awarded value/currency and extension options. If supported, deliver a concise sourced EN/FR supplier planning calendar with at most three entries under products/services/software-renewals/contracts-finder/. Distinguish award, base-term expiry, optional extension and actual open bidding; expiry alone does not establish reprocurement. Include exact official URLs, quotations, observation dates and source hashes, excluding personal contact details. If the bounded source cannot produce qualifying entries, save the precise result without broadening or creating speculative inventory. This tests a different official source, not proof of paid demand. No accounts, outreach, agreements, spending, private correspondence or public changes. Read saved outputs before closing with an actual valid lease and a lesson. Any eventual publication requires exact-digest independent review and host-gated deployment. Preserve all existing observation and retirement duties.
